review_text: They are great! Super helpful and knowledgable! Very friendly-Great place and people:-)

The absolute best vape shop ever!  During this quarantine was not able to go into the store to get my e-juice.  Called the west side location and spoke to the clerk who offered to either mail my order or even offered to deliver it to me!  they mailed it out and even called me to let me know it was on the way.  Got the order the next day!  Could not be happier with Johhny Vapes!  I'm a long time customer and this is the reason why!  They know what real customer service is and give it every day!
They have great customer services and they know what they are taking about great prices great products
Pretty cool place nice and fast they had exactly what I was looking for 👌🏾👌🏾

In from out of town for Packers training camp, the Wife and I needed some juice and a new mod.  I was absolutely amazed by the service and the store!  Everyone was really helpful, the place was very clean, and you can try out all the tanks to find out which one feels the best!  A great selection of juice and they seem to have stuff I never heard which was refreshing.  I will be ordering from them for now on as they ship for free on 2 day shipping!!  Thank you Nick and Adam!
Very knowledgeable on what’s happening and all their inventory

Best vape shop in Green Bay. Knowledgeable staff with friendly no pressure advice. Great selection and no-nonsense attitudes. Talk to Nate, Jason, Kent, or anyone behind the counter and you will not leave unhappy. 5/5 the only vape shop to go to!
